ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Medicaid provider revalidation process in Minnesota and potential fraud in the system.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How does the provider revalidation process contribute to fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and waste in the Medicaid system. By following the money and investigating the provider revalidation process, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can inform future investigations.
